title: Benzenoid ring C-H olefination of Coumarins under Rh(III)-catalysis: Synthesis, anti-inflammatory evaluation and in silico studies.
authors: Singh, Amardeep; Chopra, Manjeet; Mukherjee, Archit; Kamble, Akshay; Jain, Alok; Kumar, Hemant; Sharma, Satyasheel
one_liner_zh: 该文为香豆素类化合物的有机合成与抗炎活性研究，仅涉及小分子与TNF-alpha蛋白的对接模拟，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The C-H functionalization of coumarin benzenoid ring has been underexplored. In this study, we have carried out the Rh(III)-catalyzed C-H olefination on the benzenoid ring of coumarin at C8 and C6 position using O-carbamate directing group. The method is successfully applied to diverse range of coumarins and acrylates. Further, we have evaluated the synthesized compounds for their anti-inflammatory activity against tumor necrosis factor-alpha production in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophage cell line. Among the synthesized olefinated coumarin compounds, 4ea and 3ag were able to exhibit potent TNF-alpha expression inhibition, with IC(50) values of 6.297 muM and 11.87 muM, respectively. Further, compound 4ea was also found to inhibit the NF-kB expression. In addition, the interaction of the most potent compound 4ea with TNF-alpha dimer (PDB ID: 2AZ5) was elucidated by molecular docking and molecular simulation studies.
abstract_zh: 香豆素苯环上的C-H官能团化研究尚不充分。本研究利用O-氨基甲酸酯导向基团，在香豆素苯环的C8和C6位进行了Rh(III)催化的C-H烯基化反应。该方法成功应用于多种香豆素和丙烯酸酯类化合物。此外，我们评估了合成化合物在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞系中对肿瘤坏死因子-α产生的抗炎活性。在合成的烯基化香豆素化合物中，4ea和3ag表现出有效的TNF-α表达抑制作用，其IC(50)值分别为6.297 μM和11.87 μM。进一步研究发现，化合物4ea还能抑制NF-kB表达。同时，通过分子对接和分子模拟研究，阐明了最具潜力的化合物4ea与TNF-α二聚体（PDB ID: 2AZ5）的相互作用。
